title: Evidence review workspace
prompt: Create a complex review notebook with at least 7 cells. Overview uses metrics and an illustrative-data notice. A Group selector (All/North/South/West) and Record search jointly filter both the chart and rich table; keep reset discoverable. The rich table has thumbnail, long title, status badge, score, decision select (Pending/Accept/Reject), and Inspect action; sort and pagination must remain after decision changes. Inspect opens selected-record detail tabs (summary, image comparison, JSON). Decisions and a local draft note survive filtering and tab changes; selected view follows the clicked stable id. Include image carousel, highlighted SQL example (no SQL execution needed), full-width Markdown guidance and a scripted local chat explicitly labeled as such. Export all 18 decisions, including filtered-out records. Use families from table/vega/media/carousel/json/markdown/code/chat. Make an empty shared-filter state recoverable. All interactions must be wired.
